question: Which is the tallest self-supporting moss species found in New Zealand that usually grows to a height of 60 cm?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dawsonia superba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dawsonia superba**

 
 
• The l**argest bryophyte, *Dawsonia***, is kept in the** polytrichaceae family** and is categorised as a **moss**.
 
• Compared to other common mosses, these are **reported to grow higher and have thicker leaves**.
